description: This Python module provides classes and functions for fetching and processing weather and air quality data from the met.no API, including weather conditions, forecasts, and air quality indices.

classes.name: MetWeatherData
classes.description: Handles fetching and processing weather data from met.no API.

classes.name: AirQualityData
classes.description: Handles fetching and processing air quality data from met.no API.

methods.name: fetching_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the latest weather data from met.no.

methods.name: get_current_weather
methods.description: Returns current weather data based on the latest fetched data.

methods.name: get_forecast
methods.description: Provides weather forecast data for specified time range and zone.

methods.name: get_weather
methods.description: Extracts weather information for a specific time from fetched data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves specific weather parameters from data entries.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Asynchronously updates air quality data from the API.

methods.name: parse_datetime
methods.description: Parses datetime strings into datetime objects, using ciso8601 if available.
